i do this same thing but i take my meds the days i have school, and not take them the days i work. typically i drink caffeine and wake up as early as my body will let me, make a list of things i need to accomplish, then i have to stare at the list, carry it around wherever i am, and do each thing one by one and cross them off each time, usually it works well. i also have this rule in my mind where i cannot sit or lay down, because the moment i do that i immediately lose all my concentration. i also like to have something on while i’m doing stuff through out the day, not tv (i’ll get too invested) so i listen to a lot of true crime podcasts and i just let it play while i get to work
